biography.plain_text: Ian Roderick Gowrie-Smith is an Australian-born pharmaceutical entrepreneur and investor who founded Medeva and SkyePharma. He built the companies through acquisitions, drug-delivery technology and public-market expansion, then applied the same founder-and-investor model across biotechnology, mining and property. His later healthcare work in the United Kingdom included executive chairmanship of radiopharmaceutical developer Theragnostics.

long_biography.plain_text:
SkyePharma was Ian Gowrie-Smith's second founder-built pharmaceutical platform. He created it in 1996 after leading Medeva, then acquired the Swiss drug-delivery specialist JAGO and expanded into oral, injectable, topical and inhaled technologies. The model combined acquisitions with product development, licensing and public-market capital.

Before SkyePharma, Gowrie-Smith founded and managed Medeva, directing acquisition strategy as the specialty-pharmaceutical business expanded in vaccines, generics and respiratory medicine. He later moved between executive and investor roles across biotechnology, mining and energy. At Theragnostics he returned to healthcare as executive chairman, backing radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapies for cancer and kidney imaging. Ariceum acquired the company in 2023, carrying its diagnostic products and oncology pipeline into a larger specialist platform.
